summary: Rewrote handoff_permits_promotion() in reconcile-task-status.sh with an explicit three-way classification: exact match permits, an on-enum terminal mismatch refuses unchanged, and any value carrying no terminal claim (off-vocabulary, empty .status, unparseable JSON, or in_progress) permits with a mandatory loud diagnostic naming the offending value and the six legal values -- treating it exactly like a missing handoff. in_progress gets distinct diagnostic wording, never off-schema/malformed framing, per alignment with system-defect-discrimination.md's OFF_SCHEMA_STATUS row. Consolidated the partial branch's inline duplicate onto the same helper. Added an 11-case, 14-assertion fixture-driven regression suite in a throwaway sandbox deploy tree, proven non-vacuous by reverting the fix in a scratch copy (4 passed / 10 failed against the old code). All 4 plan phases COMPLETED.

artifacts.summary: Implementation summary covering the three-way classification rewrite, partial-branch consolidation, the regression suite, and the direct parity demonstration
4-phase plan, all phases COMPLETED, all task checklists checked off with completion/deviation annotations

decisions_made: Off-vocabulary, empty, and unparseable-JSON handoff statuses are treated as equivalent to a MISSING handoff -- same permit code path -- because they make no interpretable terminal claim
in_progress permits but with DISTINCT diagnostic wording, never off-schema/malformed framing, per system-defect-discrimination.md's OFF_SCHEMA_STATUS row
On-enum terminal mismatches (blocked/partial/failed/cross-phase success) continue to refuse exactly as before -- no relaxation

partial branch's inline duplicate consolidated onto handoff_permits_promotion; its refusal line now fires unconditionally (not dry-run-only) and calls record_refused_promotion, matching the other five call sites
Both rejected alternatives (refuse-with-diagnostic-only; known-bad-synonym table) recorded directly in the script's own comments, not just this summary, per the task's do-not-re-tighten concern

Regression suite sandbox candidate order flipped to source-store-first / deploy-tree-fallback (deviation from the plan's deploy-tree-first spec) -- discovered mid-implementation that .claude/scripts/ is a stale gitignored mirror until the next redeploy, so deploy-tree-first silently validated the OLD pre-fix code
dead_ends: Rejected refuse-with-diagnostic-only: preserves the wedge, only adds visibility
